2026_01_DEN_KC.headline: Mahomes’ return meets Denver’s pass rush in an AFC West reset
2026_01_DEN_KC.paragraph1: Kansas City gets Patrick Mahomes back from major knee surgery, but his first regular-season test comes against a Denver defense that led the NFL in sacks last season. The Broncos also return Bo Nix and added Jaylen Waddle to stress a rebuilt Chiefs secondary. With Kansas City left tackle Josh Simmons unavailable, protection against Nik Bonitto and Denver’s front is central; on the other side, Kansas City must prevent Nix and Waddle from generating explosive plays against new defensive-back personnel.
2026_01_DEN_KC.model_rationale: Kansas City’s quarterback stability and home environment meet a difficult protection matchup, while Denver’s pressure and upgraded receiving speed create credible paths to disrupt the Chiefs on both sides.
